commands: cd /workspace/owner && cat note && echo ---- && cat tab
psql -At -c "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_schema in ('sf','sf_data','gsheet') or table_name ilike '%ledger%' limit 80" 2>&1 | head -80

psql -At -c 'select column_name, data_type from information_schema.columns where table_schema='"'"'sf_data'"'"' and table_name='"'"'SALES_DW__PUBLIC__ORDERS'"'"'' ; psql -At -c 'select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema='"'"'sf_data'"'"' and table_name='"'"'SALES_DW__PUBLIC__CUSTOMERS'"'"''

psql -At -F '|' -c 'select c."REGION", count(*), round(sum(o."TOTAL_AMOUNT")::numeric,2) from sf_data."SALES_DW__PUBLIC__ORDERS" o join sf_data."SALES_DW__PUBLIC__CUSTOMERS" c on c."CUSTOMER_ID"=o."CUSTOMER_ID" group by 1 order by 1' 2>&1; psql -At -c 'select count(*), round(sum("TOTAL_AMOUNT")::numeric,2) from sf_data."SALES_DW__PUBLIC__ORDERS"'; psql -At -c 'select "STATUS", count(*) from sf_data."SALES_DW__PUBLIC__ORDERS" group by 1'

psql -At -F '|' -c 'select c."REGION", count(*), round(sum(o."TOTAL_AMOUNT")::numeric,2) from sf_data."SALES_DW__PUBLIC__ORDERS" o join sf_data."SALES_DW__PUBLIC__CUSTOMERS" c on c."CUSTOMER_ID"=o."CUSTOMER_ID" where o."STATUS"<>'"'"'Cancelled'"'"' group by 1 order by 1'; psql -At -c 'select count(*) from sf_data."SALES_DW__PUBLIC__ORDERS" o join sf_data."SALES_DW__PUBLIC__CUSTOMERS" c on c."CUSTOMER_ID"=o."CUSTOMER_ID" where o."STATUS"<>'"'"'Cancelled'"'"''
